title: Ochre Jelly Slime
summary: Throw for a small Fire burst and Burning, or use in alchemy.

fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. Impact explodes in a 3 ft radius for 1d4 + 2 Fire and applies Burning for 5 turns. The item does not specify a save.
fields.Burning: 1d4 Fire each turn. Help, healing potion, or becoming Wet can remove it.
fields.Crafting: Extract 3 slime to create Suspension of Ochre Jelly. Mix with any Sublimate to craft Elixir of Guileful Movement.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Ochre Jellies or check later-game merchants.
fields.Base value: 11 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
